title: User-selectable primary sort axis (RAM/disk-first mode)
description: Let RAM- or storage-heavy buyers (NAS, in-memory cache workloads) promote price_per_gb_ram or price_per_tb_disk to the primary sort instead of price_per_benchmark_point_multi. Direct extension of ADR-3's 'separate metrics, user decides priority' philosophy -- benchmark-value stays the documented default, this is opt-in. title: Genesis: hetzner-auction-dashboard Implementation
description:
## Genesis Bead
Tied to plan: docs/plan/plan.md

## Overview
Client-side dashboard for Hetzner server auction listings. A pipeline joins CPU benchmark scores onto listings and publishes a Parquet file (plus a companion unmatched-CPU report) to Cloudflare R2 via a temp-key-then-swap lifecycle; a static browser frontend on Cloudflare Pages using DuckDB-WASM does search/filter/sort only. The benchmark join itself is the core differentiator.

## Progress
- [ ] Phase 1: Pipeline -- fetch Hetzner auction data, define raw schema
- [ ] Phase 2: Benchmark reference table + CPU-name matching/override system + unmatched-CPU reporting
- [ ] Phase 3: Cost-metric computation + Parquet writer
- [ ] Phase 4: R2 bucket + API token + refresh-loop Deployment via declarative-config
- [ ] Phase 5: Client dashboard -- DuckDB-WASM wiring + search/filter UI
- [ ] Phase 6: Deploy pipeline to a Rackspace Spot cluster via GitOps; wire up Cloudflare Pages for web/

v1.1 additions (had-4ct, had-1vp, had-33l, had-39b, had-2ua) and v2/Future Candidates are tracked separately and do not block this genesis bead -- they are explicitly non-blocking per the plan.

title: Phase 1: Pipeline -- fetch Hetzner auction data, define raw schema
description:
Delivers: a working fetcher against Hetzner's live auction feed and a defined raw schema for what a listing looks like before any enrichment.

Completion criteria:
- Fetcher successfully retrieves and parses a real auction response end-to-end
- Raw schema fields match Data Models' pre-enrichment columns (listing_id, cpu_raw, ram_gb, disks, price_base, etc.)
- A malformed/empty response is handled without crashing (see Edge Case Catalog EC-1/EC-2)

See docs/plan/plan.md Implementation Phases.

title: Saved/named filter presets (URL-encoded)
description: Serialize current filter state into URL query params on every filter change, read back on page load -- bookmarkable, no sharing required, pure self-bookmarking for the one real user. From idea-gen run 2026-08-02, ledger finalist #5. v1.1 tier -- user explicitly deprioritized this behind core v1 functionality, hence Low priority.

title: Diff view between two Parquet snapshots
description: Client-side (IndexedDB) comparison of 'what changed since I last looked' -- cache the previous fetched snapshot and diff row-by-config-signature against the current one. Gets partial price-history value weeks before v2's full historical-stats architecture ships, with zero pipeline changes. From idea-gen run 2026-08-02, ledger finalist #3. v1.1 tier.

title: Cross-link listings to Hetzner's own Cloud catalog pricing
description: Show 'X% cheaper than the equivalent still-selling Hetzner Cloud instance' on each listing. Requires a small, separately hand-maintained lookup table mapping common CPU/RAM/disk tiers to their nearest Hetzner Cloud SKU price (catalog pricing changes rarely, unlike the 10-min auction feed, so maintenance burden is low). From idea-gen run 2026-08-02, ledger finalist #4. v1.1 tier -- note in Components as a small new lookup artifact, distinct from benchmark-map/.

title: Starter-configs + one-click best-deal button
description: Pre-built example searches (e.g. Budget web server, Home NAS, Game server) as one-click filter presets, plus a single 'best deal now' button returning one defensible top-value listing (highest price_per_benchmark_point_multi, benchmark_matched=true). For a first-time visitor who doesn't want to configure filters at all. From idea-gen run 2026-08-02, docs/notes/ideas-ledger.md finalist #1. v1.1 tier — not blocking Phase 5's core filter/sort scope.
